title: Find the name of the league in which the home team with the fewest losses d
question: Find the name of the league in which the home team with the fewest losses during the 2015/2016 season played, considering only leagues that hosted more than 100 matches in that season.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_leagues AS (
  SELECT XCL_008 AS league_id
  FROM Match
  WHERE XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY XCL_008
  HAVING COUNT(XCL_006) > 100
),
team_home_losses AS (
  SELECT
    m.XCL_013 AS home_team_id,
    m.XCL_008 AS league_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
  FROM Match AS m
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    AND m.XCL_008 IN (SELECT league_id FROM qualifying_leagues)
  GROUP BY m.XCL_013, m.XCL_008
)
SELECT l.XCL_005
FROM team_home_losses AS thl
JOIN League AS l ON thl.league_id = l.XCL_003
ORDER BY thl.loss_count ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH qualifying_leagues AS (
  SELECT XCL_008 AS league_id
  FROM Match
  WHERE XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY XCL_008
  HAVING COUNT(XCL_006) > 100
),
team_home_losses AS (
  SELECT
    m.XCL_013 AS home_team_id,
    m.XCL_008 AS league_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
  FROM Match AS m
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
    AND m.XCL_008 IN (SELECT league_id FROM qualifying_leagues)
  GROUP BY m.XCL_013, m.XCL_008
)
SELECT l.XCL_005
FROM team_home_losses AS thl
JOIN League AS l ON thl.league_id = l.XCL_003
ORDER BY thl.loss_count ASC
LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH team_losses AS (
  SELECT 
    m.XCL_013 AS team_id,
    m.XCL_008 AS league_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_count
  FROM Match m
  WHERE m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY m.XCL_013, m.XCL_008
),
league_match_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    XCL_008 AS league_id,
    COUNT(XCL_006) AS match_count
  FROM Match
  WHERE XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  GROUP BY XCL_008
  HAVING COUNT(XCL_006) > 100
)
SELECT l.XCL_005
FROM team_losses tl
INNER JOIN league_match_counts lmc ON tl.league_id = lmc.league_id
INNER JOIN League l ON tl.league_id = l.XCL_003
ORDER BY tl.loss_count ASC
LIMIT 1
